body:
**Confirmed on the iOS Simulator with a native backtrace (4.7.2-stable, ed1daf0bf)**

Self-built `template_release` (arm64 simulator, Compatibility renderer), iOS 27.0 simulator, Xcode 27.0. Breakpoint on `DisplayServer::mouse_get_position`, hit exactly once per launch:
```
#0 DisplayServer::mouse_get_position() const
#1 Window::_notification(int)
#2 Object::_notification_forward(int)
#3 Node::_propagate_enter_tree()
#4 Node::_set_tree(SceneTree*)
#5 -[GDTViewRenderer setupView:]
#6 -[GDTView drawView]
```
So the only caller is the simulated mouse-enter in the root window's `NOTIFICATION_ENTER_TREE` (`scene/main/window.cpp:1702` in 4.7.2-stable). No project code or GDExtension is involved. Happens on iPhone and iPad simulators alike. The call is unchanged on `master` (084a2caa, `window.cpp:1752`) and on the `4.7` branch (83dec14d5), so a cherry-pick of #124042 to 4.7 would be appreciated.
